
{{alias}}( x[, dim] )
    Computes the L2-norm of a single-precision floating-point vector.

    For multi-dimensional input arrays, the function performs batched
    computation, such that the function computes the L2-norm for each vector in
    `x` according to the specified dimension index.

    If provided an empty vector, the L2-norm is `0`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: ndarray
        Input array. Must have a 'float32' data type. Must have at least one
        dimension.

    dim: integer (optional)
        Dimension index for which to compute the L2-norm. Must be a negative
        integer. Negative indices are resolved relative to the last array
        dimension, with the last dimension corresponding to `-1`. Default: -1.

    Returns
    -------
    out: ndarray
        The L2-norm. The output array has the same data type as the input array
        and has a shape which excludes the reduced dimension.

    Examples
    --------
    > var xbuf = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float32}}( [ 1.0, -2.0, 2.0 ] );
    > var x = {{alias:@stdlib/ndarray/array}}( xbuf );
    > var y = {{alias}}( x )
    <ndarray>[ 3.0 ]

    See Also
    --------
